title: Size Selector
content: Create size selector component. Layout: horizontal row of size buttons. Button style: min-w-[40px] h-10 border rounded, selected state (border-black bg-black text-white). Sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL or numeric. Availability indicators: available (normal), low stock (yellow), out of stock (disabled, line-through). Size guide link opens modal with measurement table. Error state: highlight if no size selected on add to cart.

variants.simple: Create size buttons showing available sizes with selection state.
variants.detailed: Create size selector component. Layout: horizontal row of size buttons. Button style: min-w-[40px] h-10 border rounded, selected state (border-black bg-black text-white). Sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, XXL or numeric. Availability indicators: available (normal), low stock (yellow), out of stock (disabled, line-through). Size guide link opens modal with measurement table. Error state: highlight if no size selected on add to cart.
variants.advanced: Create size selector component with availability and size guide. Layout: vertical section with label "Size" and selector row. Selector: flex flex-wrap gap-2 for button row, or Select dropdown variant for many sizes. Button style: min-w-[44px] h-11 border-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all. States: unselected (border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-400), selected (border-black bg-black text-white), disabled (border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 text-gray-300 cursor-not-allowed line-through). Sizes: text sizes (XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL) or numeric (US: 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 or EU: 36, 37, 38...). Availability indicators per size button: available (normal), low stock (small amber/yellow dot indicator or "Only 2 left" tooltip on hover), out of stock (text-gray-400 with line-through text, disabled). Hover tooltip: show exact stock count on hover ("8 in stock" or "Only 2 left!"). Size guide: "Size Guide" link (text-sm underline) opens modal/drawer with measurement table. Table columns: Size, Chest, Waist, Hips, Length measurements in inches/cm toggle. Include "How to Measure" illustration. Fit recommendations: "This item runs small, we recommend sizing up" banner if applicable, based on customer feedback or product data. Remember selection: store last selected size per category in localStorage, pre-select on return visits. Error state: if user clicks "Add to Cart" without selecting size, highlight selector with red border (ring-2 ring-red-500), show inline error "Please select a size", scroll to selector if out of view. Clear selection: option to deselect by clicking selected button again. Mobile: ensure min 44x44px touch targets, consider bottom sheet for many sizes. Accessibility: role="radiogroup" with role="radio" for buttons, aria-checked, announce selection changes.
